name: sahay
description: SAHAY - AI-Powered Dynamic Mental Health Monitoring and Distress Prediction System (Smart India Hackathon Prototype)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate --workspace=apps/api && npm run db:seed --workspace=apps/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
